commands.comparison: Per-workload medians of all seven samples. Assert complete equality of 679 workload keys; check allocation calls and requested bytes in every sample.
commands.outlined_experiment: Copy final Cargo files and crates into target/m13/outlined, apply outlined-entry.patch, then cargo bench --manifest-path target/m13/outlined/Cargo.toml -p jx --bench throughput --locked with JX_BENCH_SAMPLE_MS=150 and JX_BENCH_FILTER=aggregate/array_ then plan/.

notes: Authoritative full datasets each completed uninterrupted. All benchmark processes ran sequentially. An early failed test compilation briefly overlapped the development baseline; that dataset is excluded from final comparisons.

Development CSVs retain the original and compact scratch experiments; they are not substituted into final medians. The final harness adds an explicitly lowered nested-fold case alongside the tree control.
Root plans combine validation and capture. Inside folds, candidate scanning captures fields without a separate member pass. No output is emitted before full validation.
Every evaluation workload preserves allocation calls and requested bytes; compilation allocations can change.
Rust controls use fixed fixture layouts plus complete validation and do not implement general JSONata semantics.
Final source hashes cover the engine, tests and benchmark harness. Documentation and measurement artifacts are not part of those hashes.
Focused repeats confirm main gains, ~4% mapped-constructor loss and ~3–7% unplanned numeric-array losses. The full-run 10 KiB serialization deficit does not repeat. No samples are excluded by timing.

Outlining the root plan entry shrinks the scalar entry frame but does not recover aggregate regressions and costs about 2% on tiny plans; this isolated annotation is not retained. Raw timings and patch preserve the negative result.
allocation_result: All 665 evaluation cases preserve allocation calls and requested bytes; 456 remain allocation-free.
